changelog: CEK PEMBARUAN now takes you straight to GitHub to download the latest APK (the automatic in-app update prompt still works as before). Install sessions now allow downgrades, so an older version can be installed over a newer one. The system-unzip extraction fallback now cross-checks the bundle APK count, so no extraction path can hand over an incomplete bundle. File picking and installing can no longer overlap, and a failed file preparation no longer leaves a stale install list.
